Name: SlidePushCorrectives
Description: Block dedicated to create Slide Push Correctives System

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Block dedicated to create Slide Push Correctives System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Direction: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC).
- Template parent examples: L_ArmSlideSlideDriver_Loc, L_LegSlideSlideDriver_Loc, Spine_End_Jnt.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
